intro.text: Day 21：reset 之后仍是 reset。Sottiaux（**5168 赞**）：「Day 21/ 想知道剩下七天会发生什么。但今天是 reset。」+ 疗愈系小贴士（1136 赞）：「提醒：你可以自定义网页版 ChatGPT 的外观、把它调成舒缓的。」Levie 的企业安全长文（244 赞）：「这是对当下多数大企业安全现状的准确评估。风险面的碎片化只会越来越棘手……先做好把数据与基建收拾干净的基本功，agent 才有机会帮你守护环境。」Zara 的出版观（**256 赞**）：「多数人高估一次大发布的重要性、低估每天在时间线上出现的力量——建立每天做一条视频的系统 > 花几万美元做一条发布视频。」Nan Yu 双发（129/55 赞）：「等它出现在数据或用户访谈里就太晚了——损害已经造成、名声已经受损」+ iPhone Duo 分屏模式下未优化应用的默认惨状。Peter Yang（245 赞）：用 Claude 几分钟复制任何视频 shorts 风格。Matt Turck（53 赞）：「罕见影像：VC 们如何把 2021 年押注元宇宙、游戏与挖矿的机器改造成『任务关键型 AI 基础设施』」。播客位为重播：No Priors × Greg Brockman 一期与 10-18 快照相同，已全文翻译（64 段），今日不重复。（注：上游于 10-27 重新拉取并刷新了 10-25 快照，本期按最新快照覆盖重建。）

sections.title: Security, On the Ground / 企业安全实录
sections.desc: Levie 长文（244 赞）：「风险面碎片化只会更棘手——先收拾好数据与基建，agent 才有机会帮你守护环境」；Swyx 的 ratio 小目标（10 赞）：「我还差 12 个赞就能 ratio @ArfurRock，谁有？」

rewrite: Levie's long-form ground report (244): 'Good assessment of the on the ground reality for security in most large enterprises right now. The fragmented landscape of the risk surface is only going to get more gnarly… There's a never ending set of libraries to keep up with, tools to leverage, and sprawling infrastructure, data, and code to secure. Most large enterprises can barely keep up with this, let alone smaller startups or most companies outside of tech… Data, in most organizations, is highly fragmented which means you don't really know the state of risk at any given time. Some systems are opened up privileges too broadly, and others are operating primarily via security through obscurity… Once you can get your data and infra into a better spot, at least you have a chance for agents to help you secure the environment… But everyone does need to do the hard work of getting the basics right at the start.' And swyx's ratio quest (10): 'i need 12 more likes to ratio @ArfurRock whos got it.'
original: Aaron Levie: Once you can get your data and infra into a better spot, at least you have a chance for agents to help you secure the environment.
Aaron Levie: But everyone does need to do the hard work of getting the basics right at the start.
Swyx: i need 12 more likes to ratio @ArfurRock whos got it

rewrite: Levie 的企业安全实录长文（244 赞）——「这是对当下多数大企业安全现状的准确评估。风险面的碎片化只会越来越棘手，让企业更难解决。永远追不完的库、用不完的工具、越铺越开要保护的基建、数据与代码。多数大企业勉强跟得上，更别提小创业公司或科技圈外的大多数公司。很多情况下企业需要先把技术栈现代化：多数组织的数据高度碎片化——意味着你在任一时刻都不知道风险的真实状态；有些系统权限开得过宽、有些主要靠『隐蔽式安全』（security through obscurity）撑着。要升级的太多了。一旦数据与基建收拾到位，agent 至少有机会帮你守护环境：agent 集群可以扇出、调用任何安全工具、测试各种攻击排列、读日志、处理企业数据定风险级——这能力过去几个月才出现，长时 agent 与计算机使用不够好之前都不可能。这对安全栈每一层都是巨大的机会区，也是攻防平衡上值得乐观的一个理由。但所有人都得先做好开局的苦功：把基本功做对。」Swyx 的 ratio 小目标（10 赞）——「我还差 12 个赞就能 ratio @ArfurRock，谁有？」
original: Levie：风险面碎片化只会更棘手；先收拾好数据与基建，agent 才有机会帮你守护环境；但所有人得先把基本功做对。Swyx：还差 12 个赞 ratio ArfurRock。

rewrite: Zara's shipping philosophy (256): 'Most people overestimate the importance of one huge launch and underestimate the power of just showing up every day on the timeline. Develop a system where you make a video every day > spending tens of thousands of dollars on a single launch video.' Nan Yu's pair: the reputation warning (129) — 'By the time it shows up in the data or UXR interviews it's too late. The damage has been done and the reputation tarnished' — and the iPhone Duo gripe (55): 'Anyone else find it insane that this is the default for unoptimized apps when the iPhone Duo supports split mode?' Peter Yang's triple: the Claude shorts tutorial (245) — 'Here's how to use Claude to copy any video shorts style in a few minutes' via @jake11moran's HyperFrames studio ('You just upload or pick a reference clip and then describe in the prompt what you want to change… It's still structurally the same idea') — plus 'This is beautiful. Who said AI doesn't have taste' (38) and the snack meme (12): 'lol this is me except my wife still buys snacks.' Matt Turck's pair: 'Good neighborhood' (100) and the VC remix (53): 'Rare footage of how VCs turned their 2021 bets in metaverse, gaming and crypto mining into "mission-critical AI infrastructure."' Nikunj's golden hour (40). And Dan Shipper's wordless two-image post (33).

rewrite: Replay note: today's podcast feed carries the same episode as 2026-10-18 — No Priors with OpenAI President Greg Brockman on the changing physics of cybersecurity and drug development (why security spend should vastly outstrip software spend; agents that find and fix vulnerabilities end-to-end; the 'four keys' story; AI compressing the drug discovery loop from decades to months; humans firmly in the driver's seat). The full Chinese translation (64 paragraphs) was published on 10-18; today we keep a quote replay.
original: Greg Brockman: To ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, we think that humans should be firmly in the driver's seat, should have control over the future, and this technology should amplify human agency.

Greg Brockman: You don't just want software. You want software that is reliable, that is secure, that you can believe in. And so cyber spend, security spend should actually vastly outstrip software spend.
Greg Brockman: When I look at the world we're going to be in, where software in some ways is becoming like the barrier to entry, it's becoming so cheap.

rewrite: 重播说明：今日播客快照与 10-18 相同——No Priors × OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman：网络安全与药物研发的物理规律之变（为什么安全支出应远超软件支出；端到端找漏洞修漏洞的 agent；「四把钥匙」的故事；AI 把药物发现周期从几十年压到几个月；人类应牢牢坐在驾驶座上）。完整中文译文（64 段）已收录于 10-18 期播客卡，今日不重复刊出。
original: 「为确保 AGI 造福全人类，我们认为人类应牢牢坐在驾驶座上、掌控未来，这项技术应放大人类的能动性。」
「你不只是要软件——你要的是可靠、安全、可信的软件。所以网络支出、安全支出实际上应当远超软件支出。」
